items.text: Sunny means the sun is out.
Morning is the start of the day.
Artus is the boy in the story.
Home is the place where you live.
Reads means read. He reads a book.
A book has pages with words and pictures.
About tells you what something is on. A story about owls.
Magic can make strange and wonderful things happen.
Pip is the little orange dragon. He is Artus’s friend.
Hot, bright flames. A fire keeps you warm.
Eats means eat. He eats the cake.
You make toast and sandwiches with bread.
Cheese is a food made from milk.
A house is a home. People live in a house.
To move is to go from one place to another.
Boom is a big, loud sound, like a giant walking.
What is a question word. What is that?
The big BOOM you hear in a storm.
The sky is above you. The sun and stars are in the sky.
Blue is the colour of the sky on a sunny day.
Stops means stop. It does not go on.
Looks means look. He looks out of the window.
Out means not in. They went outside.
A window is glass in a wall. You can look out of it.
Up means to a higher place.
A giant is a very, very big person, as tall as a tree.
As big as means just the same size as. A tomato as big as Pip!
Tall means very high, like a big tree.
A tree is a big plant with a trunk and leaves.
Has means have. She has a castle.
Red is the colour of fire and of some apples.
A beard is the hair on a man’s face, under his mouth.
Very means a lot. Very big is bigger than big.
A pocket is a little bag on your clothes.
Hides means hide. He goes where no one can see him.
Behind means at the back. Pip hides behind the door.
You open a door to go into a house or out of it.
Giants are very, very big people, as tall as trees.
To eat is to put food in your mouth.
Dragons are big animals with wings. Some dragons can make fire.
To know is to have it in your head. I know the way.
Down means to a lower place.
Your eyes are what you see with.
Kind means good to others. You help them.
Hello is what you say when you meet someone.
Your voice is the sound you make when you talk.
You say please when you ask for something nicely.
Your name is what people call you.
Gus is a friendly giant. He lives on a big farm.
Soup is hot food that you eat with a spoon.
Cake is a sweet food. You can have cake on your birthday.
To like something means you think it is nice.
Already means before now. I am tired already.
Shy means a little afraid to talk to people.
Your hands are at the end of your arms.
A letter is a note you write to someone. A, B and C are letters too.
Oren is a very old wizard. He lives in a tall tower.
Old means not new. It is from long ago.
A wizard is a person who can do magic.
Who asks about a person. Who are you?
Does is a form of do. What does it do?
What does Gus have for Artus?
Holds means hold. He holds the rope and does not let go.
Your hand is at the end of your arm. You hold things with your hand.
Opens means open. She opens the window.
A tower is a very tall, thin building.
Well means in a good way. You work well.
To need something is to have to have it.
Brave means you do the right thing, even when you are afraid.
Help! means: please come and help me!
To come is to move to here.
To bring is to take something with you to a place.
Excited means very happy about something.
Long means it takes a lot of time, or it goes far.
The way is how you go to a place.
Away means to another place, not here. Go away!
Asks means ask. He asks a question.
To jump is to go up into the air with your legs.
Over means across, from one side to the other.
A river is a long, long line of water that goes to the ocean.
To sit is to be on a chair or on the ground.
Puts means put. He puts the map in his bag.
A map is a picture that shows you the way to go.
Some means a few, or a little.
Food is what you eat, like bread and cheese.
You carry things in a bag.
A lot means very much, or very many.
A piece is a small part of something.
To get means to go and take something.
Hungry means you want to eat.
Smiles means smile. He makes a happy face.
Knows means know. Grandma knows about the moon.
Warm means a little hot. Nice, not cold.
Gentle means soft and careful, so you do not hurt anyone.
A room is one part of a house, with walls and a door.
A tomato is a round red food.
Soon means after a short time.
Trees are big plants with leaves.
A forest is a place with lots and lots of trees.
Wind is air that moves. You can feel it blow.
Their means it is for them. The owls can’t see their food.
Than helps you say which is more. Five is more than four.
A boat takes you over water. A boat is smaller than a ship.
Friendly means kind, like a good friend.
First means before all the others. Number one.
To stop is to not go on.
Where asks about a place. Where is the moon?
Where can Artus and Pip sit?
Lunch is the food you eat in the middle of the day.
Time is how long something takes.
A castle is a big, strong house of stone. Kings and queens have castles.
A farm is a place where people grow food and keep animals.
Around means all the way round. They fly around the room.
A carrot is a long orange food that grows in the ground.
Beans are long green food that grow on a plant.
A field is a big open place with grass or food plants.
Every means all of them, one by one.
A ball is round. You can play with a ball.
Gives means give. She gives him a bell.
Night is when it is dark and you sleep.
Light helps you see. The sun gives light.
Comes means come. The owl comes in.
Makes means make. The beaver makes a boat.
Strong means you can carry big, heavy things.
Brown is the colour of wood and of chocolate.
A chicken is a farm bird. A chicken makes eggs.
A horse is a big animal. You can sit on its back.
Gets means get. He gets the rope.
An egg is round and has a shell. Baby birds and baby dragons come out of eggs.
Made means make, but in the past.
Honey is a sweet, gold food. Bees make it.
More means extra. A bigger amount.
What makes the food on the farm big?
What do they eat for lunch?
After means later. First this, and after that, the next thing.
Shows means show. May shows them a door.
The end is the last part of something.
Leaves are the green parts of a tree. One leaf, two leaves.
Grey is the colour of rain clouds.
Carrots are long orange food that grow in the ground.
Thin means not fat. A thin stick.
Why asks for a reason. Why are you sad?
Sad means not happy. You feel like you want to cry.
Sick means not well. You feel bad.
Bright means full of light. The sun is bright.
The time when the sun is up.
Land is the ground, not the water.
A town is a place with lots of houses and people.
Animals are living things like owls, foxes, fish and dragons.
Not warm. Ice and snow are cold.
Goes means go. The boat goes down the river.
Helps means help. Artus helps Bell.
You say thank you when someone is kind to you.
A friend is someone you like, and who likes you.
Stands means stand. He gets up on his feet.
On his back means behind him, on his body.
A path is a small way to walk on.
To fall is to go down fast, by mistake.
To give is to let someone have something.
To take is to get something and hold it, or go with it.
What does Gus take for Oren?
Along means on, going the long way. Walk along the road.
A road is a long way for people and horses to go on.
Woods are a lot of trees, like a little forest.
Dark means there is no light.
Quiet means with very little sound.
Careful means you go slowly and look, so nothing bad happens.
To look is to use your eyes.
Birds are animals with wings and feathers.
To fly is to move in the air, like a bird.
Going means moving to a place.
A bird is an animal with wings and feathers. Most birds can fly.
Flies means fly. The owl flies up into the sky.
Two is the number after one.
Happy means you feel good and glad.
Proud means happy because you did something good.
To see is to use your eyes.
A big animal with wings. Some dragons can make fire.
Best means better than all the others.
A snack is a little food between meals.
To walk is to go on your feet, not fast.
How asks the way to do something. How can we get there?
How does Pip help the birds?
A lake is a lot of still water with land all around it.
You drink water. Rain is water.
Here, still means the path keeps going for a long way.
Across means from one side to the other. Walk across the road.
To hold is to have something in your hands.
Below means under, lower down. The stones are below the water.
Oh is what you say when you are surprised.
If tells you what will happen when something else happens.
To make is to put things together, so there is a new thing.
A spell is magic words that make magic happen.
White is the colour of snow and clouds.
Three is the number after two. One, two, three.
Worried means you think something bad may happen, and you feel upset.
The top is the highest part.
Why must Gus see the stones?
Why is Artus a little worried?
A hill is like a little mountain.
Above means over, higher up. The sky is above us.
Clouds are white or grey, high up in the sky.
To wait is to stay here until something happens.
Beside means next to. Gus sits beside the door.
Stairs are steps that go up and down in a house or a tower.
Ten is the number after nine. 10.
Eleven is the number after ten. 11.
Twelve is the number after eleven. 12.
Tired means you want to rest or sleep.
Books are things you read. They have pages with words.
Maps are pictures that show the way.
A man is a grown-up boy.
Sitting means sit. He is sitting by the fire.
You put a hat on your head.
Gold is a yellow, very bright metal. Crowns and coins can be gold.
Stars are small bright lights in the night sky.
To find is to look and then see the thing you want.
Your head is the top part of you, with your eyes, nose and mouth.
Silly means funny, not very clever.
Why does Gus wait by the door?
Only means just this one, no more.
Round is the shape of a ball or a coin. Round and round means in a circle.
A stone is a little rock.
A small bright light in the night sky.
Farms are places where people grow food and keep animals.
Green is the colour of grass and leaves.
Keeps means keep. She keeps the ship safe.
A year is a long time: 365 days. A hundred years is a very long time.
New means you did not have it before.
Letters make words: a, b, c. A letter is also a note you send.
To read is to look at words and know what they say.
Not yet means not now, but later.
To think is to use your mind.
Until means up to the time when.
What does the Star Stone do?
When will the books sit still?
To hop is to jump in little jumps.
Jumping means going up into the air with your feet.
High means a long way up.
Falls means fall. It goes down fast.
Walls are the sides of a room or a castle.
Against means up on something, touching it. The book hits against the wall.
Sees means see. Jet sees a hole.
While means at the same time. The book is still while he reads.
Other means a different one, not this one.
To want something means you would like to have it.
To hear is to use your ears.
Stopped means stop, in the past. The books have stopped.
To love is to like something very, very much.
What does a book do when Pip jumps up?
How does Artus get the books to stop?
Let me help means please can I help.
Pages are the pieces of paper in a book.
To open is to make a way in. Open the door!
Got Jet down means they helped him come down.
Without means not with. We can’t do it without the pages.
A page is one piece of paper in a book.
A very, very big hill. It is high and has rocks.
Where is the big spell book?
What is not right with the spell book?
Who sees where the pages are?
Snow is soft and white and very cold. It comes down from the sky in winter.
Wings help a bird or a dragon fly.
Pulls means pull. He pulls the rope to him.
Hot means very warm. The sun is hot.
Thinks means think. Pip thinks of a good idea.
The sun is the big bright light in the sky in the day.
Work is a job that you do.
An idea is a new thought. A good plan in your head.
Why can’t Pip make a big fire?
How does Pip get the page out?
A trunk is the big wood part of a tree, under the leaves.
Its means it has it. The fox has a red tail: its tail is red.
Bark is the hard skin on a tree.
Your face is the front of your head, with your eyes, nose and mouth.
Looking means using your eyes to find something.
To put is to move something to a place.
Roots are the parts of a tree under the ground.
Dirt is the brown ground that plants grow in.
Finds means find. He finds the page.
Dirty means not clean. Pip has dirt on his hands.
A seed is a very small thing that a plant grows from.
The ground is what you stand on outside.
A smile is the happy face you make when you are glad.
How does Gus help the tree?
What does the tree give Artus?
Friends are people you like, and who like you.
The moon is big and round, and it gives light in the night sky.
Chocolate is a sweet brown food. Hot chocolate is a warm drink.
A pan is a pot for making hot food.
A cup is a small thing you drink from.
Biggest means more big than all the others.
Drinks means drink. Gus drinks it all.
At once means all of it, very fast.
Cookies are small, sweet, round food.
Sweet means it tastes like cake or honey.
A cookie is a small, sweet, round food.
Second means number two. First, second. A second is also a very short time.
Third means number three. First, second, third.
Fourth means number four. First, second, third, fourth.
When must they do the spell?
How many cookies does Pip have?
Almost means very close, but not yet.
A word is a group of letters that means something. Cat is a word.
Words are groups of letters that mean something.
To say is to tell something with words.
A sound is something you hear.
How many words are in the spell?
What does Oren say to do with the long word?
What does the stone do after the fourth word?
A thousand is ten hundreds. 1,000. A lot!
A village is a very small town.
Houses are buildings where people live.
Men are grown-up boys. One man, two men.
Girls are children who will grow up to be women.
Boys are children who will grow up to be men.
What comes out in the sky?
How long will the stone be bright now?
People means men, women and children.
A boy is a child who will grow up to be a man.
Had means have, but in the past.
A plate is a flat round dish for food.
A bowl is a round dish for soup or cake.
To show is to let someone see something.
Sleeps means sleep. Pip sleeps in the pocket.
Full means there is no more room.
What does Gus bring on a big plate?
What does Artus do with the seed?
